purpose: Productized control plane for generated artifacts in hermetic Rust cloud-ci. It declares generated-output path rules, which generated artifacts exist, who owns them, how they materialize, and why generated outputs must be ignored by default or regenerated from source instead of hand-merged.
public_product_contract: Any repository adopting oya-ci can provide this manifest plus an SCM-facts snapshot to the Rust gate. GitHub Actions is a bridge runner; the policy is CI-provider-neutral, hermetic, and suitable for native cloud-ci execution. Generated outputs matching generated_path_rules are ignored by default; any force-added generated output must be declared here with owner, generator, materialization mode, and non-source merge policy.

artifacts.final_tree_validation: FROZEN-REFERENCE BASELINE, DE-COMMITTED (ADR-0616, supersedes ADR-0596). This face is the firewall ratchet's FROZEN reference AND the candidate baseline; it is now NOT tracked in git. The scm-facts emitter REGENERATES the FROZEN reference by running the accounting producer over the `git merge-base <base_ref> HEAD` SOURCE worktree (the ratchet policy declares frozen_reference.source: regenerate-from-merge-base-source) — it is NO LONGER read from a committed git blob via `git show <merge-base>:<this-path>`. Removing that committed blob is exactly what makes de-commit safe: with no blob to empty there is no #828 empty-frozen deadlock, and the retired `git show` fallback cannot silently produce an empty reference (regen is the sole path, fail-closed). Trust is the hyperscaler recompute-don't-commit model (Bazel affected-set / Tricorder): the emitter regenerates the frozen baseline TWICE and asserts the two project identically (determinism canary), and binds the regeneration to the merge-base tree via provenance (base_tree_sha). The freshness gate proves the CANDIDATE baseline by regeneration-success + regenerate-twice determinism (the same class as every other de-committed face) rather than byte parity against a committed copy — a committed copy would list itself in tracked_paths and mutate on every PR, the faces-serialization cascade this de-commit kills. cloud-ci materializes the candidate baseline from source before gates consume it.
artifacts.public_product_contract: The baseline ratchet is shrink-only generated policy; the frozen reference is regenerated from the merge-base source and validated by determinism + provenance, never a committed merge surface that could launder new debt.

artifacts.final_tree_validation: ADR-0604 de-commit class (completes the ADR-0595 strangler): this SCM-facts boundary snapshot is the LAST committed pure-derivation face and is now NOT tracked in git. cloud-ci materializes it on demand from the accepted final tree (the scm-facts emitter, the single out-of-graph git boundary) before gates consume it; the firewall's FROZEN reference (gate-baseline) stays committed and is unaffected. The freshness gate requires it to regenerate successfully and to be byte-stable across two regenerations (determinism canary); registry-drift byte-compares two fresh regenerations of the snapshot. Byte parity against a committed copy is intentionally retired for this face, because a committed copy lists itself in tracked_paths and so mutates on every PR — the exact faces-serialization cascade this de-commit kills. The protected-branch push trigger and merge-queue projected-state controller still regenerate SCM facts from the accepted final tree; branch-head facts are advisory only for squash-only merge paths.
artifacts.public_product_contract: SCM facts are the single non-hermetic boundary snapshot. Native cloud-ci must materialize them from the accepted final tree, not hand-merge branch-head JSON.

artifacts.final_tree_validation: ADR-0563-amended de-commit class (ADR-0614): this face is NOT tracked in git; cloud-ci materializes it on demand from the checked-out candidate tree. //ci/facade/generated-artifact-freshness:oya-cloud-ci-materialize-generated-faces-bin runs the codemod `manifest` subcommand as step 1 (materialize_move_manifest) before the scm-facts emitter's rename-aware relabel consumes it. The registry-drift gate validates regenerate-twice determinism (two fresh codemod emissions of the manifest must be byte-identical), not committed-byte parity. Byte parity against a committed copy is intentionally retired for this face; the reviewed move surface is the committed move-plan (specs/reorg/<capability>-move-plan.json) plus git rename detection, not a committed bijection.
artifacts.public_product_contract: The authoritative CI-materialized move bijection the rename-aware path-keyed CI baseline relabel consumes (task #64): file-level pairs (brand-residue path-keyed relabel), crate-DIR pairs (total-accounting/target-parity existence relabel), and crate-IDENT pairs (tier-dep endpoint mapping). The file-level + crate-DIR pairs are derived from the candidate POST-move tracked tree (NEW-dir descendants mapped back to OLD), so a real move yields a NON-empty manifest. It is a pure function of committed inputs (move plan committed at specs/reorg/<capability>-move-plan.json + candidate tree); a no-move PR yields the canonical empty manifest (identity relabel). De-committed under ADR-0614 (amends ADR-0563): never a contributor merge surface, materialized on demand rather than committed. Never hand-edited; the codemod is the sole generator.

source_inputs: merge-base source worktree (git show equivalent, read via plain fs from the checkout)
artifacts.final_tree_validation: De-commit class: this face is NOT tracked in git; cloud-ci materializes it on demand. //ci/facade/generated-artifact-freshness:oya-cloud-ci-materialize-generated-faces-bin reuses the SAME merge-base source worktree it already checks out for frozen-baseline regeneration (the one sanctioned git boundary) to read each declared normal-source-merge artifact's content at the merge-base — a plain filesystem read, no additional git call. Consumed by the generated-output-diff-policy gate so it can verify a hand-curated-ratchet baseline's plain-modify content diff (shrink-only / move-plan-backed substitution, see specs/reorg/move-manifest.generated.json) without itself calling git (ci-gate-self-conformance forbids subprocess/network/clock/randomness primitives in gate production code).
artifacts.public_product_contract: Declared normal-source-merge artifact path -> its content at the merge-base. An artifact absent from the merge-base tree (e.g. brand new) is simply omitted; the consuming gate fails closed on it. Never hand-edited; the freshness materializer is the sole generator.

source_inputs: human review of the friction ledger legacy debt at ADR-0544 gate go-live
artifacts.final_tree_validation: HAND-CURATED-COMMITTED (not producer-regenerated): the reviewed, hand-shrunk shrink-only ratchet reference for the friction-ledger legacy debt set frozen at ADR-0544 gate go-live. The live-repo gate test asserts the MEASURED legacy set equals these keys EXACTLY (set equality). It MUST stay a committed git blob and MUST NOT be recomputed over the candidate tree — a candidate recompute would erase the hand-shrunk burn-down and re-launder aged-out debt. Declaring it with any de-commit materialization_mode is RED (hand_curated_ratchet_artifact_must_stay_committed).
artifacts.public_product_contract: A human-authored shrink-only debt baseline is governed by the control plane: it cannot be silently de-committed or recomputed, only reviewed-shrunk.

source_inputs: human-frozen tier-dependency violation set captured on the live tree at gate birth (ADR-0245/0280/0562)
artifacts.final_tree_validation: HAND-CURATED-COMMITTED, FROZEN-INTENT: the frozen known-debt baseline of pre-existing tier-dependency violations; the gate reports these advisory and blocks only on a NEW code|subject not in the set (subset/no-regression semantics). It has a local `--emit-baseline` producer, but that producer MUST NOT own the committed face: a candidate recompute would absorb (LAUNDER) new regressions into the baseline. It MUST stay a committed git blob, burn down only by reviewed removal, and MUST NOT be de-committed to a candidate recompute. Declaring it with any de-commit materialization_mode is RED (hand_curated_ratchet_artifact_must_stay_committed).
artifacts.public_product_contract: A frozen subset/no-regression debt baseline is governed by the control plane: its own emit-baseline producer is advisory only and can never recompute the committed reference over the candidate tree.

source_inputs: human-frozen storage-port trait set captured on the dev tip at ADR-0570 gate birth

It MUST stay a committed git blob and MUST NOT be recomputed over the candidate tree. Declaring it with any de-commit materialization_mode is RED (hand_curated_ratchet_artifact_must_stay_committed).
artifacts.public_product_contract: A hand-frozen no-regression port-placement baseline is governed by the control plane: it cannot be silently de-committed or recomputed, only reviewed-shrunk.

artifacts.final_tree_validation: This current-tree facts face is controller-produced and NOT tracked in git. The controller validates the immutable protected-null, candidate-exact-three control contract against the predecessor snapshot before materializing facts. It contains lifecycle and object/path/blob/hash/length observations only and cannot assert qualified closure.
artifacts.public_product_contract: History-only retirement facts are an ignored controller projection, never a contributor merge surface or closure receipt.

development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.name: Project creation
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.automation: Scaffold generated-artifact manifest rows, default artifact classes, native cloud-ci runner configuration, and required documentation pointers before the first commit.
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.enforcement: New project templates fail self-check if generated artifacts can appear without a manifest row.

development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.name: Local authoring
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.automation: Editors and local checks can run the same Rust predicate over the manifest and SCM-facts snapshot for fast advisory feedback.
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.enforcement: Local findings are advisory only; merge authority remains the hermetic cloud-ci gate.

development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.name: Pre-commit and pre-push
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.automation: Fast checks reject undeclared generated outputs, normal-source merge policies for tracked generated artifacts, and contributor-branch generated-output edits before a branch reaches CI.
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.enforcement: Hooks may block local pushes, but the server-side generated-output diff policy, freshness gate, and Rust gate repeat the check and remain authoritative.

development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.name: Pull request presubmit
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.automation: Hermetic Rust gates run over committed manifest plus materialized SCM-facts snapshot; presubmit rejects generated-output edits in contributor PRs and requires declared generated artifacts to be regenerated or controller-materialized from source.
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.enforcement: The single fan-in context oya-ci-required turns red on undeclared generated artifacts, unsafe merge policies, stale declared materialized artifacts, or generated outputs used as ordinary source merge surfaces.

development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.name: Merge queue projected state
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.automation: A trusted controller resolves generated-only conflicts by regenerating from the projected source tree and reruns final-tree validation before queue admission.
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.enforcement: Source conflicts fail to the fix loop; generated conflict hunks are not accepted as authority.

development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.name: Postsubmit and main materialization
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.automation: Native cloud-ci materializes canonical aggregate artifacts from the accepted tree, records digests, and emits audit telemetry.
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.enforcement: Drift on the protected branch creates a repair action and fails closed if the artifact is undeclared.

development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.name: Release and deployment
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.automation: CD consumes only generated artifacts with declared provenance, owner, source inputs, and final-tree validation evidence.
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.enforcement: Release packaging rejects undeclared or drifted generated artifacts.

development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.name: Operations and drift repair
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.automation: Scheduled controllers detect drift, create repair PRs, and report generated artifact metrics by class and materialization mode.
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.enforcement: Missing policy rows and failed regeneration remain red until repaired through the same manifest-controlled workflow.

final_tree_materialization.portable_runner_contract: The controller runs after source-tree projection and after protected-branch updates. It regenerates declared artifacts from the accepted tree, records digests, and treats handwritten generated-output conflict resolution as invalid input.
